The branch added convergence_mode and depth_mode to line 17 (diff hunk at line 14) and left this list untouched, so the two binding surfaces in one file disagree. Reproducer: /deep:research:confirm --depth-mode=expansive; an executor that follows the first-action list literally binds no depth_mode and then meets a start condition that says the YAML may not load without it, while the command standard forbids inferring missing input. Impact: the operator's depth-mode flag can be silently dropped to the default, which disables the feature they asked for with no error. findings.issue: The table headed 'Runtime-supported lifecycle modes' lists new, resume and restart, and the sentence directly below it declares completed-continue a live mode set by --extend=N, so the section contradicts itself and the table is the wrong one. The sibling deep-review/SKILL.md was updated to list completed-continue inline, which makes the research table the only stale copy of the lifecycle set. Reproducer: an operator asks which lifecycle modes /deep:research supports and reads the table; completed-continue does not appear in it. Impact: a reader planning an --extend run is told the mode does not exist in the one place built to answer the question, and may fall back to a restart that archives the packet instead.

evidence.out:
Runtime-supported lifecycle modes:

| Mode | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| `new` | First run against the spec folder |
| `resume` | Continue the active lineage and append a typed `resumed` JSONL event |
| `restart` | Archive the existing research tree, mint a fresh `sessionId`, increment `generation`, and append a typed `restarted` event |

`completed-continue` is set by `--extend=N`: it reopens a completed run in the same session and generation, raises the iteration cap to the runs so far plus N, and appends a typed `run_extended` event.

fix.old: | `restart` | Archive the existing research tree, mint a fresh `sessionId`, increment `generation`, and append a typed `restarted` event |
fix.new:
| `restart` | Archive the existing research tree, mint a fresh `sessionId`, increment `generation`, and append a typed `restarted` event |
| `completed-continue` | Reopen a completed run in the same session and generation, raise the iteration cap to the runs so far plus N, and append a typed `run_extended` event (set by `--extend=N`) |
